snippet.title: INKARO TRAILER - Steam Page Reveal | Upcoming Brutal Parkour Indie FPS
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3926130/INKARO/

Music by ‎⁨@llwll_⁩  

INKARO is an upcoming indie parkour FPS that will take place within an infinite hell dimension of decaying plastic and rustic concrete. Inspired by Tsutomu Nihei's 'Blame!' manga, Half-Life, DUSK and Titanfall.
